target.statement: KCM achieves mean AUROC of 0.871 across the 47 ADBench datasets (highest among 46 label-free detectors), with the untrimmed variant giving 0.866.

compute.basis: KCM is closed-form (O(N^2 D) bandwidth selection + O(NMD) scoring, capped at N0=2000), paper reports median fit 0.33 s and worst total 38.5 s per dataset on one CPU core; the cost is downloading ADBench (47 datasets) and running the full sweep over 3 seeds, plus verifying the repo reproduces the exact 0.871.

blockers: Repo link is provided but not verifiable here; if code/configs are incomplete the closed-form KCM must be re-implemented from Algorithm 1 (feasible but adds time)
ADBench download is large (47 datasets, some with >1000 features and large sample counts) and needs preprocessing to the semi-supervised 50%-normal splits
Baseline numbers (DTE-NP, LUNAR, etc.) come from the TCCM benchmark and are not re-run, so only KCM's own mean AUROC is reproducible
title: Mitigating Convergence Collapse in Fixed-Target Anomaly Detectors via Kernel-Anchored Locality Regularization
